findings.title: Fastify production advisory
findings.finding: The internet-facing service ships fastify@5.6.2 despite the recorded high-severity production advisory and available fixed release.
findings.action: Upgrade Fastify and compatible plugins/lockfile entries to the fixed line and rerun focused security checks, or complete explicit advisory-specific security acceptance before deployment.

findings.title: Public draft/private CMS disclosure
findings.finding: The public content endpoint returns inactive campaigns, draft news and reports, non-public documents, and their asset URLs; visibility filtering happens only in React.
findings.action: Project visible content for public reads and add a bearer-protected full-document endpoint for the admin editor.

findings.title: No account-wide login throttle
findings.finding: The username-focused rate-limit key also contains request.ip, so distributed sources reset both focused controls against the single administrator identity.
findings.action: Add an independent username-hash/account control with deployment-appropriate shared state and test one username across changing IPs.

findings.title: Cacheable donor response
findings.finding: The protected donation response contains donor PII but does not send Cache-Control: no-store.
findings.action: Set and test a no-store policy on protected donation-report responses.

findings.title: Spreadsheet formula injection
findings.finding: CSV serialization quotes cells but does not neutralize donor-controlled values beginning with spreadsheet formula prefixes.
findings.action: Sanitize dangerous leading characters, including after whitespace/control characters, before CSV quoting and add focused tests.

findings.title: Deleted migration history accepted
findings.finding: Migration checks iterate only current source files, so an already-applied migration can disappear while migration execution and latest-version health still report current.
findings.action: Compare complete applied/source version-name-checksum sets, reject missing source history, test deletion and rename, and align readiness with complete history.

findings.title: No PostgreSQL migration exercise
findings.finding: The migration DDL and apply-twice behavior were tested only through fake queries, not executed by PostgreSQL.
findings.action: Apply migrations twice on a Railway-matching disposable PostgreSQL instance, assert the singleton row/revision, and retain changed-history evidence.

findings.title: No interactive contact-flow check
findings.finding: Hidden login success/failure, API timeout fallback, ordinary mail preparation, and direct-route session restoration were not exercised in a browser.
findings.action: Run the documented staging smoke matrix with real Railway credentials before production.
